t: Russian Forces Hit Data Centers Used by Ukraine's Military – MoD
d: The Russian army struck data centers, Ukrainian port infrastructure facilities, as well as sea vessels involved in the interests of the Ukrainian military overnight, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Sunday.
